scope: frozen static calibrated and boundary-aligned baseline
allowed: Use as the C0-calibrated, C1 boundary-aligned public process-network baseline
blocked: No strict independent C1 claim; no Tata digital-twin claim; no DA, stochastic, CVaR, mFRR, quarter-hour, bidding, clearing, product-revenue, or full settlement logic
required_inputs_or_checks: Preserve S3.3j caveats: combined 6 PJ/y utility sink provisional-source-supported; 3/3 PJ NG/WAG split placeholder; Vattenfall fraction 1.0 interface abstraction only
outputs_or_gate: Frozen reference for physical hardening and regression checks.

scope: physical flexibility guardrails and constraint evidence audit
allowed: Add or audit explicit max capacities, finite stores, terminal rules, grid bounds, WAG allocation/flaring, utility balances, ramp/minimum-load guardrails where evidence or governed assumptions exist; review hourly semi-continuous binary EAF guardrail candidate
blocked: No DA price response; no stochasticity; no CVaR; no mFRR; no quarter-hour; no bidding/clearing; no product revenue; no detailed EAF heat sequencing or sub-hour restart logic
required_inputs_or_checks: Guardrail checks must pass before S4.1: active assets have explicit max capacity; storage variables have finite upper bounds; intertemporal buffers have terminal rules; WAG balances close; spillage/flaring explicit and reported; grid import/export bounded or disabled; EAF is not a smooth continuous dimmer; named infeasibility diagnostics/IIS used where available
outputs_or_gate: Constraint-evidence audit, EAF/DRP promotion shortlist and guardrail pass/fail record under governed S3/S4 candidate-review area.

scope: static-price or zero-price regression after guardrails
allowed: Run static-price or zero-price regression using the hardened physical model
blocked: No DA price-taking interpretation if deviations are unexplained; no market-layer logic
required_inputs_or_checks: Compare against S3.3j static behaviour and explain any deviations as physical hardening rather than price response
outputs_or_gate: Regression memo with solver status, model size, balance residuals, terminal residuals, capacity/ramp/buffer hit summaries.

allowed: Use exogenous hourly DA prices for price-taking dispatch under fixed production policy
blocked: No bidding, clearing, stochastic scenarios, CVaR, mFRR, quarter-hour, product revenue, export revenue, or full settlement logic
required_inputs_or_checks: DA modes may not run unless S3.4/S4.0a guardrail checks and S4.0b static-price regression pass; every volatile price input needs timestamp, source, and scenario tag
outputs_or_gate: Deterministic 24h and 168h smoke records with physical feasibility, production fulfilment, and DA energy-cost diagnostics.

scope: realised-price cost reporting and careful benchmarks
allowed: Report realised-price cost under deterministic price-taking; define price-insensitive benchmark carefully; keep perfect foresight as later oracle/upper-bound only
blocked: No submitted bids or clearing claims; no expected-profit-only reporting; no production-revenue objective
required_inputs_or_checks: Separate optimisation-stage objective from realised-price cost reporting; report average price paid, grid peaks, WAG flaring, capacity/ramp/buffer hits, terminal residuals, and balance residuals
outputs_or_gate: Compact governed run folders only once implementation begins; experiment registry entry; no root-level generated outputs.

allowed: Proceed only after deterministic hourly DA price-taking is explainable and physically feasible
blocked: DA bidding/clearing/settlement, stochastic scenarios, mFRR, quarter-hour or D+4, CVaR, detailed EAF heat sequencing, and binary commitment are blocked until their labelled stages
required_inputs_or_checks: One-dimensional stage changes only; validation-like selection for later scenario/CVaR choices; no final-test tuning
outputs_or_gate: Later stage-gate records must preserve the S3.4/S4.0a physical guardrail checks.
